Blue Lantern Corps

Brother Hynn

A link in the Blue Lantern recruitment chain.

Brother Hynn is an early Blue Lantern in the recruitment chain following Saint Walker and Warth. His role shows how hope passes from one recruit to the next.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Blue Lantern Corps
First appearance
Green Lantern #38 (2009)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Warth selects Hynn, and Hynn subsequently chooses Sister Sercy. His appearances on Odym place him within the small Blue Lantern community before Blackest Night. Those scenes establish an early affiliation; they do not justify a claim that he remains an active member in every later era.
